compatibility.instructions: Does this grain preserve all contracts: no product code, schema, API, MCP, migration, donor, or config change; only one decision record plus one conformance test file? Any changed behavior?

evidence.instructions: Is evidence sufficient: 8/8 new conformance tests pass, full python suite 205/205 green, hygiene PASS, graft build/check green, no network in CI? Any prose-only closure of a requirement?

reliability.instructions: Any risk in the record: all counts re-derived from sources on every run (directory-prefix counts, route glob, tool-schema scan, package scan), keyboard/virtualization honesty enforced both directions (Skelet keyboard must exist, virtualization must stay unclaimed), revisit triggers recorded instead of open-ended deferral?

scope.instructions: Anything beyond the AC-02 decision: runtime transplant, board code change, P10/P13/P14 work, embeddings, billing, UI, or unrelated refactors? Is the virtualization follow-on correctly left as future work rather than smuggled scope?

security.instructions: Does the grain weaken any control: keep rationale rests on rights (no donor rights model), handoff ledger, and isolation (no new client-only surface, no donor code, no network in CI)?
